hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, parkID 50026 (19 Sunset Ridge 'Electric' sites: Electricity Hookup '20/30/50', Water Hookup 'Y'; no site lists a sewer hookup; 30 Basic and 3 Tent sites none), read 2026-10-27

values.note: cpwshop lists 52: 30 basic sites in Bookcliff Campground (vehicles to 27-90 ft, mostly pull-through), 19 electric sites in the new Sunset Ridge Campground (to 38 ft, 3 pull-through) and 3 tent sites.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/highline-lake-state-park/highline-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Camping is available year-round at 56 campsites') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (Maximum Vehicle Length up to 90; Driveway Entry 'Pull-Through' on 26 sites), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Showers and laundry may close in winter; the dump station and water spigots stay open. Visitor-center store sells camping supplies, firewood and ice.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/highline-lake-state-park/highline-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Shower and laundry facilities (may be closed during winter)', 'Dump station', 'Water'; 'The Camper Services Building with flush toilets and showers is open year round'; 'Winter amenities: Dump station, Water spigots') + park page ('the park's retail store carries gifts and items needed for camping'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/highline-lake-state-park/highline-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Highline Lake's campground is open year-round'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required (cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613), up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days within a 28-day period. Some grass sites close on flood-irrigation days. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/highline-lake-state-park/highline-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Highline Lake State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'; 'During watering days, certain campsites are closed for the day'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: June nights: basic sites $28, electric $36, the same on a Saturday (CPW's park page gives $21-36 across seasons). Plus tax, CPW's reservation fee and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $80 a year at this park).

fees.source: co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop 2027-06-15: Bookcliff Basic '$28.00 /Per Night', Sunset Ridge Electric '$36.00'; 2027-06-19 the same) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/highline-lake-state-park/highline-lake-state-park-camping-lodging (Single campsite '$21 - $36'; Park Pass '$4 - $80'), read 2026-10-27

note: Highline Lake State Park NW of Grand Junction near Loma (I-70 exit 15): Bookcliff Campground (basic sites) and the newer Sunset Ridge Campground (electric) beside Highline Lake. --Claude
summary: CPW park and camping pages + every cpwshop site page: confirmed 56 sites, showers/laundry/flush toilets/dump, reservation required on cpwshop (fcfs never), $28 basic + $8 electric. Added 50 A electric with water at the 19 Sunset Ridge sites (no sewer), rigs to 90 ft, pull-throughs, drinking water, store, year-round season, 180-day window, 14-night max. Note dropped field restatements.
